key.name: workspace-id
key.description: OpenCode workspace id, e.g. wrk_XXXXXXXX from the console URL

key.name: auth-cookie
key.description: Session cookie value from opencode.ai console (DevTools → Application → Cookies)

key.name: refresh-minutes
key.description: How often usage is refreshed; minimum 1 minute

key.name: show-panel-badge
key.summary: Show the percentage badge in the panel
key.description: Display the headline percentage next to the panel icon

key.name: warn-percent
key.description: Percentage at which bars, the threshold tick and the panel badge turn amber

key.name: critical-percent
key.description: Percentage at which bars and the panel badge turn red; keep above the warning level

key.name: enable-history
key.description: Stores the last 7 days of usage percentages on this device to draw the trend sparkline and pace estimate

key.name: tray-display-mode
key.description: Which usage windows to display next to the panel icon: weekly, fiveHour, monthly, all, none

key.name: enable-notifications
key.description: Show desktop notification when usage exceeds threshold

key.name: notification-threshold
key.description: Percentage threshold to trigger desktop notification (50-95%)

key.name: notify-rolling
key.description: Include the Rolling (5h) window in quota notifications

key.name: notify-weekly
key.description: Include the Weekly window in quota notifications

key.name: notify-monthly
key.description: Include the Monthly window in quota notifications

key.name: compact-mode
key.description: Reduces padding and height in the hover popup menu for smaller screens or denser layout

key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to toggle the OpenCode Go usage popup

key.name: hover-to-open
key.description: Automatically open the usage popup when hovering over the top panel icon
